About

I am studying for a Higher National Diploma in Information Technology at SLIATE Badulla Campus. I like taking a problem, such as tracking student attendance or keeping stock records in order, and turning it into a working application that different kinds of users can rely on.

My strongest foundation is Java web development. I have built complete systems with login, role-based dashboards, database records and generated reports. I am now looking for an internship where I can work on real front-end or back-end tasks and learn from a team.
